name: sanverite-skills
description: Companion skills for mattpocock-skills. Ships review-assist (a reading plan for human review of a change, with its change surface and cURLs), peer-review (a blind review of a diff, spec or tickets by Codex, reconciled against the host agent's own review), review-all (both reviews plus a reading plan with every finding pinned to its step) and architect (requirements-first system design, with every stack choice traced to a requirement). Not an official Matt Pocock plugin.
